stories.headline: Anthropic Signs $10 Billion Compute Deal With Startup Volta for a Norway Supercomputing Site
stories.key_takeaway: Anthropic's $10B, six-year deal with eight-month-old startup Volta shows AI compute is now financed like bankable infrastructure, using J.P. Morgan credit backstops to make future GPU payments creditworthy.

pull_quote.text: Compute has become a new infrastructure asset class, with AI models and applications as the verticals built on top. Railways carried industrialization. Our ambition is to build the utility of compute so that compute works as reliably and invisibly as electricity.

stories.article_excerpt: A company that did not exist eight months ago just became one of the most important names in Anthropic's supply chain.

stories.headline: Anaconda Buys Enkrypt AI to Secure the 'Trillion-Token Enterprise'
stories.key_takeaway: Anaconda acquired AI-security startup Enkrypt AI to add pre-deployment red-teaming, runtime guardrails and compliance automation to its platform, betting that at agent scale enterprises need provable trust, not just speed.

pull_quote.text: There's a difference between running AI, and running AI safely. Trust can't be added after an agent ships, it has to be built into and run on a trusted foundation from day one.

stories.article_excerpt: Anaconda has spent a decade as the plumbing beneath enterprise Python. Now it is betting on the next problem: not whether AI agents move fast, but whether anyone can prove what they are doing.

stories.headline: Google Consolidates AI Power in California as Hassabis Steps Up to Chairman
stories.key_takeaway: Google is consolidating AI decision-making in California by promoting Koray Kavukcuoglu to SVP reporting to Sundar Pichai, while Demis Hassabis shifts to chairman and Alphabet Chief Scientist to focus on AGI and Isomorphic Labs.

pull_quote.text: I've been working towards AGI my whole life and now, like many of you, I feel it is close at hand.
pull_quote.role: Chair, Google DeepMind and Chief Scientist, Alphabet

stories.article_excerpt: Google reshaped the command structure of its most valuable asset, elevating a little-known engineer to run its AI empire and moving Demis Hassabis into a chairman's seat.

stories.headline: BYD Unveils Its First Humanoid Robot as Automakers Pile Into Embodied AI
stories.key_takeaway: BYD is unveiling its first humanoid robot, 'Xiao Di,' in early August at its Di Space venues, joining a wave of automakers repurposing EV manufacturing, battery and control expertise for embodied AI amid China's robotics race.

pull_quote.text: It won't show up with a pile of specs and jargon. Maybe when you walk closer, it moves slightly.
pull_quote.role: Official BYD promotional description of Xiao Di

stories.article_excerpt: The world's largest maker of electric vehicles wants to sell you a car. Increasingly, it also wants a robot to do the selling.

stories.headline: Google.org Commits $15 Million to a New Digital Futures Fund Cohort
stories.key_takeaway: Google.org added $15M to its Digital Futures Fund for a new 2026 cohort of think tanks and universities studying AI's impact on jobs, energy and security, reviving questions about a leading AI company underwriting the research meant to govern it.

pull_quote.text: Artificial intelligence is a once-in-a-generation opportunity to strengthen economies, drive scientific breakthroughs and bolster global cybersecurity. Realizing AI's potential goes hand-in-hand with a commitment to its responsible development.
pull_quote.role: VP and Global Head of Google.org

stories.article_excerpt: Google.org has poured another $15 million into the debate over how to govern artificial intelligence, naming a fresh cohort of think tanks and academic institutions.

stories.headline: 'Tokenmaxxing Is Not What We're Optimizing For': Microsoft Puts Divisions on AI Token Budgets
stories.key_takeaway: Microsoft is putting its divisions on formal AI token budget targets and defaulting internal Copilot to the cheaper GPT-5.6 Sol, signaling an industry pivot from measuring AI by raw consumption to measuring it by ROI and impact per token.

pull_quote.text: Tokenmaxxing is not what we are optimizing for. I want all of us focused on maximizing outcomes that move the needle for our customers and our business.

stories.article_excerpt: For two years, Microsoft's pitch to the corporate world was to put a copilot in front of every employee and let it run. This month, it started telling its own engineers to slow down.

stories.headline: Simon Willison Ships LLM 0.32, Deepening the Open-Source CLI's Tools and Fragments
stories.key_takeaway: LLM 0.32, which Simon Willison calls his most significant release since launch, adds visible reasoning traces, provider-run server-side tools, a Git-style logging store and GPT-5.6 support, pushing the open-source CLI toward a full agent framework.

pull_quote.text: I guess LLM is an agent framework now... Looking at LLM today it's beginning to look very agent-shaped to me.
pull_quote.role: Creator of the LLM open-source CLI

stories.article_excerpt: When Simon Willison pushed version 0.32 of his open-source llm tool on August 4, he called it the most significant new version since the project's launch.

stories.headline: 'Exploratory Sampling' Aims to Make LLM Outputs Genuinely Novel, Not Just Reworded
stories.key_takeaway: Exploratory Sampling trains a lightweight distiller at test time to predict a model's deep-layer hidden states from shallow ones, using prediction error as a novelty signal to steer tokens toward under-explored ideas rather than surface-level rewording.

pull_quote.text: We use the prediction error as a novelty signal to reweight candidate token extensions.
pull_quote.attribution: 'Large Language Models Explore by Latent Distilling'

stories.article_excerpt: Ask a large language model for ten story ideas and you usually get one idea wearing ten outfits. Closing that gap is the target of a 2026 decoding method called Exploratory Sampling.

stories.headline: 'Tool-DC' Uses Divide-and-Conquer to Fix How LLMs Pick the Right Tool
stories.key_takeaway: Tool-DC reframes tool selection as a decomposition problem: by splitting large tool catalogs into small parallel groups with a Try-Check-Retry loop, its training-free version yields up to +25.10% average gains and its trained version lifts Qwen2.5-7B past OpenAI o3 and Claude Haiku 4.5 on BFCL.

pull_quote.text: The core of Tool-DC is to reduce the reasoning difficulty and make full use of self-reflection ability of LLMs via a Try-Check-Retry paradigm.

stories.article_excerpt: When an AI agent has three tools to choose from, picking the right one is trivial. Give it thirty, and something quietly breaks.

stories.headline: Latent World Models Let Language Models Plan Against Compressed State, Not Raw Tokens
stories.key_takeaway: A 2026 wave of research trains latent world models, often jointly with a language model, to compress environment or reasoning state into dense vectors so the model can plan against compact latents instead of raw token sequences, cutting compounding error on long-horizon tasks.

pull_quote.text: JEPA-style latent world models provide an efficient alternative to pixel space prediction by learning action-conditioned dynamics in compact representation spaces.

data_points.label: Avg improvement over prior SOTA on long-horizon control

stories.article_excerpt: A language model asked to plan ten steps ahead has had only one place to think: the token stream. A wave of 2026 research argues that is the wrong substrate for planning.

stories.headline: MAS-Orchestra Trains Multi-Agent Systems With Function-Calling RL and Debuts MASBENCH
stories.key_takeaway: MAS-Orchestra reframes multi-agent design as one-shot function-calling reinforcement learning, training a 7B orchestrator to compose an entire agent system at once; paired with the new MASBENCH benchmark, it reports beating GPT-5 and Claude-Sonnet-4.5 by up to 23%.

pull_quote.text: Agent orchestration is performed using sequential, code-level execution that limits global system-level holistic reasoning and scales poorly with agent complexity.

data_points.label: Peak gain over GPT-5 and Claude-Sonnet-4.5

stories.article_excerpt: The pitch for multi-agent systems has been intuitive: if one language model is smart, a team should be smarter. The reality has been messier.

stories.headline: 'Act As a Real Researcher': A New Benchmark Suite Tests LLMs Across the Full Research Lifecycle
stories.key_takeaway: A new benchmark suite tests LLM agents on researcher-like judgment across the research lifecycle, not just code execution, and finds the best configuration tops out at just 68.3%, undercutting claims that AI is ready to work as an autonomous scientist.

pull_quote.text: Despite their evolution from research assistants into autonomous research agents, these systems still exhibit significant limitations in field sensitivity, research ethics, and nuanced scientific judgment.

stories.article_excerpt: Give a modern coding agent a well-specified experiment and it will often run the thing end to end. A new benchmark asks a harder question: would you trust it as a research intern?

stories.headline: Ninth Circuit Frees Perplexity's Comet Agent to Shop Amazon, Vacating an Injunction
stories.key_takeaway: The Ninth Circuit vacated Amazon's injunction against Perplexity's Comet browser, holding that under the CFAA it is the user, not Perplexity, who accesses Amazon, because the AI Assistant is a tool, not a person for statutory purposes.

pull_quote.text: However advanced the [AI] Assistant currently is, it is a tool, not a person for statutory purposes.
pull_quote.attribution: U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit

stories.article_excerpt: A federal appeals court handed the AI industry its first major appellate win on whether software agents can roam the web on a user's behalf.

stories.headline: White House to Host OpenAI, Anthropic and Google on a Voluntary AI Safety-Testing Framework
stories.key_takeaway: The Trump administration convened OpenAI, Anthropic and Google to review a finished, explicitly voluntary framework for pre-release safety testing of frontier AI models, built from a June executive order that bars any mandatory licensing regime.

pull_quote.text: The Administration's expected action this week on frontier AI could be an important step toward closing the gap between innovation and governance.

data_points.label: Orgs Anthropic's models hacked in testing

stories.article_excerpt: The Trump administration gathered the biggest names in AI at the White House to walk them through a finished national framework for voluntary safety testing of the most powerful models.

stories.headline: Rust Publishes an LLM Policy: Bots Can Review and Refine, but Not 'Create'
stories.key_takeaway: Five Rust teams adopted a formal LLM policy for rust-lang/rust that permits AI for answering, analyzing and reviewing but bans it for creation, with mandatory disclosure of any LLM use and dishonesty treated as a Code of Conduct violation.

pull_quote.text: It's fine to use LLMs to answer questions, analyze, distill, refine, check, suggest, review. But not to create.

stories.article_excerpt: When the Rust project finally wrote down its rules for AI, the entire philosophy fit in a single sentence: help, refine, review, but do not create.
